integrity: Two independent complete finite enumeration methods (14-vertex restricted-growth partitioning and Fano-side partition merging) agree on the entire 2751-element optimum set, on 11662 recolouring moves, all component sizes and their degree histogram. C++17 and Python 3 standard-library sources included.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite Heawood graph classification; no larger-projective-plane extension is claimed. Historical priority outside inspected literature is unresolved; no independent scholarly audit.
title: Optimal total-dominator colourings of the Heawood graph: mixed classes and two mobility sectors
